guide.rematter.page.1:
ReMatter Guide

Start with the Hand
Preparator.
Build a Cell,
Drive, Decomposer
and Synthesizer.
Decompose Sand to
learn its material,
then make Glass. A
Cell holds real
stock; research
never adds matter.
guide.rematter.page.10:
First network

Drive: Machine Frames
in the corners, Cell
Racks to either side
of a Control Circuit,
Structural Bars
above and a Mint
Matrix Crystal below.
guide.rematter.page.11:
First network

Place Decomposer
and Synthesizer
beside the Drive.
Insert a Cell in any
bay and supply FE to
both processors.
guide.rematter.page.12:
Sand into storage

Open Decomposer.
Insert Sand in its
input and press Start.

Its cutter separates
stored Silica into the
connected Drive.

The Cell stays in
storage. Processors
do not accept new
Cells.
guide.rematter.page.13:
Read the tabs

Machine: inputs,
outputs and
upgrades. Settings:
sides, production
and access.
Terminal also has
Machines. Analyzer
has Research.
Preview is separate
from the real
output slot. Hover
for details.
guide.rematter.page.14:
Make glass

Choose recipe. Find
Glass. Use recipe,
then Make 1.

Collect the Glass from
the Synthesizer.

Default: 1 Sand to 1
Glass, 24,000 FE total.
The Cell remains in the
connected Drive.
guide.rematter.page.15:
Control work

Make one queues a
finite batch.
Repeat requests
more until paused.
Pause keeps the
order. Settings
controls automation
and network jobs.
Hoppers can feed
input and remove
actual output.
guide.rematter.page.16:
Why a crystal?

Heating bonds the
mineral blend into a
porous crystal matrix.
Selective storage in
that matrix is fiction,
inspired by real
material separation.

A Cell holds stock.
Recipes describe
products; they add no
matter.
guide.rematter.page.17:
Powered preparation

Material Preparator
uses FE. Inputs run
left to right; unused
slots stay empty.

Grind Iron, Copper or
Gold Ingots into Dust,
1:1, for 4,000 FE each.

No Cell needed.
guide.rematter.page.18:
Five useful fractions

Sand gives Silith. Clay
Ball gives Argil.

Powered preparation
also gives: Redstone:
Rhedon. Quartz: Virel.
Glowstone: Lumin.

Each extraction costs
2,000 FE. Silith + Argil
makes Matrix Blend.
guide.rematter.page.19:
Alloy powders

Powered inputs, left to
right: Rhevon: 3 Iron
Dust, 1 Copper Dust, 1
Rhedon. Lumivex: 3
Copper Dust, 1 Gold
Dust, 1 Lumin.

Each batch makes 4
Powder for 8,000 FE.
Heat next.
guide.rematter.page.2:
Hand Preparator

Top: Flint, Iron, Flint.
Middle: Copper, Iron,
Copper. Bottom: 3 Iron
Ingots.

Insert feedstock and
press Crank until the
batch finishes.
guide.rematter.page.20:
Virelite Ceramic

Mix with FE: 1 Silith + 1
Argil + 1 Virel = 4
Virelite Powder.

Sinter Furnace: 1
Powder to 1 Ceramic
for 12,000 FE.

Rhevon and Lumivex
Powder sinter into
Ingots at the same
cost.
guide.rematter.page.21:
Heat and recycle

Alloy Powder smelts
or blasts to Ingots,
1:1.

Preparator, Mekanism
Crusher and Oritech
Pulverizer grind
Ingots back to the
same Powder.

Oritech Foundry: 2
Powders to 2 Ingots.
guide.rematter.page.22:
Advanced powders

Powered, left input
only: Diamond: Powder.
Emerald, Lapis,
Amethyst: Dust. Ender
Pearl: Powder.
Netherite Ingot:
Powder.

No Cell needed.
guide.rematter.page.23:
Component blends

Left, middle, right:
Diamond Powder, 2
Matrix Blend, Gold
Dust.

Ender Pearl Powder, 2
Lumivex Powder,
Copper Dust.

Netherite Powder, 2
Rhevon Powder,
Virelite Powder.
guide.rematter.page.24:
Sinter components

Sinter Furnace, 1
Blend: Diamond Lattice:
12,000 FE. Ender
Conductor: 16,000 FE.
Netherite Sheath:
24,000 FE.

Lattices: circuits,
upgrades. Conductors:
Cells, Ports.
guide.rematter.page.25:
Larger Cells

Each Cell stores up to
512 types: 4M, 16M,
64M and 256M units
(4k to 256k ingots).

16M uses a Matrix
Cluster and Rhevon.
guide.rematter.page.26:
Larger Cells

64M uses 2 Clusters,
Optical Circuit,
Diamond Lattice and
2 Ender Conductors.
256M adds a Mint
Crystal, 2nd Optical
and Netherite Sheath.
guide.rematter.page.27:
Preparation Reactor

Shell: 3–9 wide and
deep, 5–9 high. Use at
least a 3×4 or 4×3
footprint and 2 Ports.

Cutter + Filter +
Basin mount inside on
the floor or ceiling.
guide.rematter.page.28:
Preparation
hardware

Cutters give
grinding capacity;
Basins give mixing
capacity. Filters
add Precision.
Hardware does not
grant extra global
speed or FE
savings. Speed and
Efficiency upgrades
do that.
guide.rematter.page.29:
Research a material

Decomposition
consumes a
supported sample
and teaches its
family. The
Analyzer keeps its
sample and spends
FE instead. One
family may cover
several forms.
Imported cells
teach nothing.
guide.rematter.page.3:
Extract two fractions

Left input: 1 Sand.
Leave the other two
empty. Crank for 1
Silith.

Collect it; repeat with
1 Clay Ball for 1 Argil.

These are useful
mineral fractions, not
pure elements.
guide.rematter.page.30:
Research has limits

Synthesis still
needs an explicit
approved output.
Research cannot
unlock machines,
equipment or parts
for synthesis.
Diamond forms also
need a Pressure
Module. Shared team
knowledge is not
copied on leaving.
guide.rematter.page.31:
Water later

Connect Chemical
Processor to a Drive
with a Cell. Supply FE.

Import a water bucket
through Decomposer;
keep its input empty.

Choose Water
electrolysis, Use
recipe, then Make 1.
guide.rematter.page.32:
AE2 and RS

Use one Network
Interface per
system. In
Settings, choose
its backend and
enable automation.
Enable Network jobs
on supported
workers. Crafting
follows the same
research, hardware
and transfer rules.
guide.rematter.page.33:
Chemical Reactor

Use a complete
shell and two or
more Ports. Field
Stabilizers grant
Field; Reaction
Foci add 16,000 u
input room each.
More hardware
unlocks capacity,
not free speed or
FE savings.
guide.rematter.page.34:
Expand the network

Each Drive holds six
removable Cells. Start
with one.

Up to 64 Drives.
Nodes: 256, 384 or
512 by lowest cable
tier.
guide.rematter.page.35:
Useful upgrades

Every processor has
separate Speed and
Efficiency slots.
Speed scales to 10x
(+25% FE each).
Efficiency doubles
FE buffer (to 16x),
offsets Speed cost
1:1, then saves 5%
FE each (to -20%).
Sneak-click to fit.
guide.rematter.page.36:
When work waits

Check matter, inputs,
FE and output room.
Cables link the
network and forward
pushed FE.

After a Cell or
guide.rematter.page.37:
When work waits

network change, the
batch restarts by
itself.

Keep unreadable Cells
safe.
guide.rematter.page.38:
Before you start

Gather iron, copper,
redstone, gold, sand,
clay, flint and glass.

For your first FE,
build the Crystal
Generator (p. 66).

The starter Drive
guide.rematter.page.39:
Before you start

needs 1 diamond; the
Synthesizer needs 3
emeralds. Glass
teaches controls.
Build next for silicon,
bronze or steel.
guide.rematter.page.4:
Form the matrix

Left: 1 Silith. Middle: 1
Argil. Right: empty.

Crank for 4 Matrix
Blend. No water
needed.

Process each Blend
in the Hand Preparator
for 1 Matrix Crystal.
guide.rematter.page.40:
Useful silicon

With a supported
silicon mod, ReForging
uses quartz: 1 quartz
-> 1,000 crystalline
silica -> 1,000 silicon
+ 1,000 oxygen.
guide.rematter.page.41:
Useful silicon

Synthesizer: 250
silicon per item. Four
items cost 160,000
base FE in total. Keep
or explicitly vent new
oxygen.
guide.rematter.page.42:
Chemical processes

Chemical Processor
handles electrolysis,
reactions, separation,
heating and cooling.
Soil yields carbon,
silica and water;
carbon helps make
steel.
guide.rematter.page.43:
Crystal outputs

The Material
Synthesizer makes
approved crystals.
Diamond forms use
its Pressure Module
slot, leaving both
Speed and Efficiency
slots free. Export
stored liquids here
too.
guide.rematter.page.44:
Air and byproducts

Choose Air oxygen in
Chemical Processor:
200 oxygen, 16,000
base FE, 400 ticks.
Overworld, air above
and open sky.
Mekanism tubes can
export oxygen from
guide.rematter.page.45:
Air and byproducts

an automated Drive.

Production settings
can vent selected NEW
gases, after
confirmation. Stored
gas stays safe.
guide.rematter.page.46:
Stock targets

Settings:
Production. A
target of 0
disables the limit.
Processes count
stored substance
and phase; physical
outputs count the
local buffer.
Complete batches
must fit under the
ceiling.
guide.rematter.page.47:
Parallel work

Up to 3 Parallel
Upgrades allow 4
industrial lanes
when height and
hardware permit.
Every batch pays
its full price. All
lanes share the
same matter budget.
Total FE savings
cannot exceed 25%.
guide.rematter.page.48:
Ownership and repairs

Cables and machines
belong to their placer.
Foreign cables do not
connect. FTB Teams
members can operate
devices without
merging stock.
guide.rematter.page.49:
Ownership and repairs

Invalid chamber: use
Preview to highlight
mismatches, or use
Auto-Build when the
full volume is clear.
guide.rematter.page.5:
Craft parts

Frame: Structural
Bars in the corners,
Iron Ingots along the
edges and Matrix
Blend in the center.

Circuit: Copper Ingots
in the corners,
Redstone above and
below Matrix Blend,
and Argil to its left
and right.
guide.rematter.page.50:
Material knowledge

Machine owner and
current team share
knowledge. Personal
discoveries stay
personal; team
knowledge stays
with the team on
leaving. Learn
cheaply from a
sample.
guide.rematter.page.51:
Derive without a
sample

Analyzer Research
can derive a
material if every
required substance
is known. Use its
own Primal Cell.
Base price:
4,000-16,000 u
Primal, 256,000 FE
and 90 seconds. No
item is produced.
guide.rematter.page.52:
Primal Ore

Deepslate Primal
Ore appears in new
Overworld terrain
at y -60 to -24.
Mine with iron
tools or better.
Each ore gives one
Shard. Fortune
gives no bonus;
Silk Touch keeps
the ore.
guide.rematter.page.53:
Other dimensions

Nether Primal Ore
appears at y 16-96.
End Primal Ore is
on outer islands;
the central island
is excluded. All
variants have the
same value. Old
chunks are not
refilled.
guide.rematter.page.54:
Separate Primal
Cells

Primal Cells hold
only Primal Matter:
16k, 64k, 256k or
1M u. A Shard or
ore loads 1,000 u.
Ordinary Cells
reject Primal.
Drive bays can hold
both types, with
separate totals.
guide.rematter.page.55:
Load and move
Primal

Right-click a
Primal Cell with
Shards, ore or
another cell.
Transfer keeps
exact amounts.
Analyzer and
Converter pay only
from their own
payment slot.
guide.rematter.page.56:
Primal Converter

Search a known
solid element by
name or symbol.
Check its ratio.
Insert a Primal
Cell and supply FE.
The flow shows the
output Drive, Cell
bay and free space.
Choose a finite
amount, then Start
and Confirm.
guide.rematter.page.57:
One-way prices

For 1,000 u output:
common elements
cost 1,000 u
Primal; scarce
2,000; invented
4,000. Choose steps
of 250 u. The
window shows exact
FE and time.
Upgrades cannot
improve the Primal
rate.
guide.rematter.page.58:
Discovery Lens

Build the Lens from
8 Primal Crystals
and advanced
optics. Install it
in the Analyzer.
Discovery needs 32
earned materials,
both industrial
structures and the
required owner
dimension visits.
guide.rematter.page.59:
A random discovery

Choose a tier, not
a hidden material.
Discovery finds one
eligible,
still-locked family
in that tier. Base
costs: 16, 32 or 64
Shards and 5, 10 or
20 minutes. The
result is
knowledge, not an
item.
guide.rematter.page.6:
Bars and Racks

Structural Bars: Iron
Ingots across the top
and bottom rows, Silith
left and right in the
middle. Makes 12.

Cell Rack: Bars down
both sides, Control
Circuits top and
bottom center, Silith in
the middle. Makes 2.
guide.rematter.page.60:
A persistent
project

Pause, reload and
machine changes
keep the same paid
project and hidden
order. Known
targets are
skipped. If the
pool becomes known,
paid Primal is
refunded once.
guide.rematter.page.61:
Reactor hardware

Each Field
Stabilizer adds
Field; special
processes require 4
or 8. Each Reaction
Focus adds 16,000 u
room for active
inputs. Extra empty
shell space does
not multiply
recipes.
guide.rematter.page.62:
Precision and lanes

Filters grant
Precision. Cutters
and Basins provide
capacity for each
step. Height
permits 1-4
industrial lanes,
but Parallel
Upgrades and enough
hardware are also
required.
guide.rematter.page.63:
Hardware colours

Amber crystals:
preparation.
Violet crystals:
reaction.

Hardware grants
capabilities and
room. Upgrades
control work.
guide.rematter.page.64:
One matter budget

Basic: 128 u/t.
Reinforced: 1,024.
Resonant: 8,192.
The best usable
path sets one
budget per
controller. Inputs
and outputs both
count. More equal
cables do not add
speed.
guide.rematter.page.65:
One FE budget

Native cable FE/t:
Basic 2,048;
Reinforced 16,384;
Resonant 131,072.
All controller
ports share their
budget and the
131,072 FE/t total
cap. Additional
cables do not stack
their rates.
guide.rematter.page.66:
Crystal Generator

Top center: Ember.
Middle: copper block,
frame, copper block.
Bottom: bars, circuit,
bars. Use side ports.

Loose plain crystal:
768 FE at 128 FE/t.
Industrial: 512 FE/t.
Colours yield up to
2,816 FE per crystal.
guide.rematter.page.67:
Primal Crystals

Precision 4
Preparation
Reactor: 4
Shards + 1 Matrix
Crystal make 1
Primal Crystal.
Preview shows FE
and time. It makes
Lens, Cells and
Links; no Primal
reclaim.
guide.rematter.page.68:
Entangled Link

Pair two owned Links
with a Link item or
Configuration Card.
Max 32 blocks, same
dimension, both
loaded. Acts as one
Basic link without
chunk loading.
guide.rematter.page.69:
Milestones and care

Optional
advancements point
to the next useful
step. They grant no
synthesis
permission. Keep
unreadable cells
and machines safe:
unknown contents
are preserved, not
replaced with empty
stock.
guide.rematter.page.7:
4M Matter Cell

Housing: Bars in
the corners, Glass
along the edges.
Stack Circuit,
Matrix Crystal and
Housing. Installed
crystals stay
reusable. A
generator consumes
a loose crystal
instead.
guide.rematter.page.70:
Energy Cubes

Store FE for later.
Basic: 4M (1+1 bays).
Reinforced: 32M (2+2).
Resonant: 256M (4+4).

Charge or discharge
FE items, including
Portable Energy Cells.
guide.rematter.page.71:
Energy sides

Front starts Output;
others start Input.
Sides can be Input,
Output, Input/Output
or Disabled.

Energy and items
stay when moved.
guide.rematter.page.72:
Cell Transfer
Station

Insert a Source Cell
on the left and a
Target Cell on the
right. Choose All
or selected
substances, then
Transfer or Swap.
Only what fits moves.
Primal Matter stays
separate.
guide.rematter.page.73:
Filter a Cell

Open Cell Filter and
choose Source or
Target Cell. Click
substance badges or
copy its Contents.
The saved filter
also applies in
Drives. Existing
contents can leave;
an empty filter
accepts nothing.
guide.rematter.page.74:
Connection sides

Fronts never
connect, except
Energy Cubes. Open
bench tops never
connect. Sealed tops
start Disabled;
enable in Sides.
Blank means Disabled.
Left click forward;
right click or Shift
steps back.
guide.rematter.page.75:
Machine motion

Off means idle.
Device colour means
working. Breathing
blue means waiting
for input, output
room, a target or
energy. The menu
gives the current
reason. Moving parts
slow smoothly when
work pauses.
guide.rematter.page.76:
Substance details

Hover matter for its
exact amount, phase
and type. Right-click
for its formula and
composition. Scroll
the details to read all.

With EMI, use the
recipe and use keys,
or the two link icons.
These views never
unlock research.
guide.rematter.page.77:
Industrial lines

Build an Industrial
Decomposer or
Synthesizer like a
Chemical Reactor:
casing, glass, Ports,
Stabilizers & Foci.
2x base speed, up to
4 parallel lanes.
The Synthesizer has
Tier 2 pressure
built in.
guide.rematter.page.78:
Auto-eject & speed

Compact processors
scale up to 10x speed
with 4 Speed Upgrades.

Under Settings ->
Access, enable
Auto-eject to push
finished items into
adjacent storage on
active output sides.
Config Cards copy it.
guide.rematter.page.79:
Wireless & Curios

Bind Terminal & Lens
hotkeys under
Controls -> ReMatter.

With Curios, wear
Terminal (Charm),
Energy Cell (Belt),
Spectrometer Lens or
Discovery Lens (Head
or Charm) and toggle
the HUD on or off.
guide.rematter.page.8:
Colored crystals

Mix a Matrix Crystal
in a Preparator with
one dust: Gold: Amber
Copper: Copper
Diamond: Mint
Emerald: Leaf
Lapis Lazuli: Blue
Amethyst: Violet
Silith: Ice
Redstone: Ember.
guide.rematter.page.9:
Starter machines

With Frames, Circuits
and Bars: Preparator:
2 Amber. Decomposer:
2 Copper. Synthesizer:
3 Leaf, Glass. Drive: 1
Mint, 2 Racks.

The recipe book
shows each grid.

tooltip.rematter.energy_cube.rate: Transfer: %s FE/t shared across all faces and charging slots
tooltip.rematter.guidance.analyzer: Keeps its sample while learning a material. Needs FE; Derive and Discovery use an explicit Primal Cell.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.atmospheric_co: Harvests ambient gases directly into network storage at double speed and efficiency.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.cell_transfer: One Source Cell and one Target Cell. Select substances to transfer and save substance/phase filters on Cells.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.configuration_: Sneak-right-click to copy settings or select an Entangled Link; right-click to apply or pair.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.converter: Explicit finite batches turn a separate Primal Cell into known, allowed solid elements. Never replaces missing ordinary ingredients automatically.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.decomposer: Consumes supported samples, learns their material and stores their substances in a connected ordinary Matter Cell. Needs FE.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.discovery_lens: Upgrades the Spectrometer Lens for Analyzer Discovery. Keeps full Curios/hotkey spectrometry; synthesis still requires research.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.drive: Six removable cell bays. Ordinary matter and Primal reserves stay separate; unknown contents remain preserved.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.efficiency_upg: Up to 4 per processor: each doubles the internal FE buffer (up to ×16), offsets one Speed Upgrade's +25% FE surcharge, and saves 5% FE per extra upgrade (up to -20%). Sneak + right-click a machine to install.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.energy_core: Shared Ember capacitor core used in Portable Energy Cells, Wireless Terminals and every Energy Cube tier.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.energy_cube: Buffers FE and charges compatible items. Configure input and output faces in Sides. Energy, side modes and slot items stay when moved or upgraded to higher tiers.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.entangled_link: Bridges two Matter Cable runs up to 32 blocks apart; pair two owned links with a Configuration Card.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.field: Adds Field. Advanced reactor procedures use Field %s or %s; extra Field does not improve yield or save FE.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.generator: Fuel yield: %s to %s FE per permitted crystal, at %s FE/t. Consumes the crystal completely; data packs may adjust or disable fuel entries.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.grinding: Adds capacity for grinding steps inside a Preparation Reactor; it does not multiply recipe yield.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.hand_contents: Holds items or unreadable data. Place and empty it before upgrading.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.hand_preparato: Crank basic recipes without FE. Only an empty, unmodified Hand Preparator can be used for the powered upgrade.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.industrial_dec: Needs a formed reactor shell, Field and process room. Breaks down items and fluids at high throughput through Machine Ports.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.industrial_pre: Needs a formed shell and FE. Adds direct chains, exact reclaim, Precision recipes and Assay.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.industrial_rea: Needs a formed shell, Field and process room. Hardware grants capabilities; upgrades control speed, efficiency and parallel jobs.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.industrial_syn: Needs a formed reactor shell, Field and process room. High-throughput synthesis with built-in Tier 2 crystallization for diamonds and blocks.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.interface: Connects a supported AE2 or RS backend. Native crafting follows the same research and machine gates.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.key_crystal: A reusable functional key when installed in a device. Burning this loose item in an enabled generator consumes it.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.matter_level_e: Connects to Matter Cables at the bottom or back; emits Redstone strength 15 out the front when network stock meets its threshold.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.matter_wrench: Right-click to apply the active mode (Ports, Rotate, or Dismantle); sneak-right-click to switch modes.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.mixing: Adds capacity for mixing steps inside a Preparation Reactor; it does not add a global speed bonus.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.parallel_upgra: Industrial chambers only (up to 3): adds individually paid concurrent lanes (up to 4 total). Sneak + right-click a controller to install.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.portable_energ: 4M FE pocket battery; charge or discharge in any FE dock, or sneak-right-click to auto-recharge FE items in your inventory.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.precision: Adds Precision for separation and recipes that require finer control. It does not discount FE.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.preparator: Powered grinding and mixing of physical ingredients. No Matter Cell required.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.pressure_modul: Material Synthesizer (1 slot): unlocks Tier 2 crystallization for diamond forms without occupying Speed or Efficiency slots. Sneak + right-click to install.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.pressurized_ca: Holds 16,000 units of one liquid or gas substance, or 16 buckets of one fluid. Fill or drain via Terminal, machines, or Mekanism chemical tanks.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.reactor: Rearranges ordinary stored substances. Needs FE; industrial-only procedures require the multiblock Chemical Reactor.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.room: Adds %s u of simultaneous recipe-input room. Additional chambers do not add their own speed bonus.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.shared_budget: One shared budget per controller. The best usable path wins; equal paths and extra ports do not add their rates.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.sinter_furnace: Heats prepared physical batches with FE. Needs no Matter Cell.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.spectrometer_l: Wear in Curios (Head/Charm), hold, or carry to inspect full compositions and ambient gases before research. Synthesis still requires research.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.speed_upgrade: Up to 4 per processor: scales processing speed up to ×10 (+25% FE per unmatched Speed Upgrade). Sneak + right-click a machine to install.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.synthesizer: Makes only explicitly approved, researched materials. Needs FE and ordinary stored matter; diamond forms also need a Pressure Module.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.terminal: Search shared ordinary stock and inspect authorized connected machines.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.void_matter_ce: Finite cells fill first; discards excess ordinary matter only after finite space is full. Partition in a Cell Transfer Station.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.wireless_acces: Connects to Matter Cables and FE at the bottom or back; serves Wireless Matter Terminals (128 to 512 blocks with Wireless Boosters).
tooltip.rematter.guidance.wireless_boost: Install up to 16 in a Wireless Access Point to extend range from 128 to 512 blocks.
tooltip.rematter.guidance.wireless_matte: Right-click or dock in a Wireless Access Point to bind, charge or discharge with any FE mod or Energy Cube, then right-click to open.
tooltip.rematter.portable_energy_cell.to: Sneak + Right-Click in air to toggle auto-charge
tooltip.rematter.pressurized_canister.hi: Right-Click or Sneak + Right-Click machines or Shift-Click Terminal liquid/gas rows
